author: David Hobson

quote: Clearly older women and especially older women who have led an active life or elder women who successfully maneuver through their own family life have so much to teach us about sharing, patience, and wisdom.
author: Alice Walker

quote: I'd like to be more patient! I just want everything now. I've tried to meditate, but it's really hard for me to stay still. I'd like to try to force myself to do it, because everybody says how wonderful meditation is for you, but I can't shut my mind up. So patience and learning is the key.
author: Ellen DeGeneres

quote: I have not the smarts or patience for political office.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: Affliction is the wholesome soil of virtue, where patience, honor, sweet humility, and calm fortitude, take root and strongly flourish.
author: David Mallet

quote: I think you can judge from somebody's actions a kind of a stability and sense of purpose perhaps created by strong religious roots. I mean, there's a certain patience, a certain discipline, I think, that religion helps you achieve.
author: George W. Bush

quote: As anyone who has ever been around a cat for any length of time well knows, cats have enormous patience with the limitations of the human kind.
author: Cleveland Amory

quote: Patience is the art of concealing your impatience.
author: Guy Kawasaki

quote: Patience has its limits, take it too far and it's cowardice.
author: Holbrook Jackson

quote: With love and patience, nothing is impossible.
author: Daisaku Ikeda

quote: When I was 20, I thought I was 30 - but I was so far from it. When you're young, you want everything to happen now. As you mature, you can look back and see all the great things you achieved with time and patience.
author: Elisha Cuthbert

quote: You can learn many things from children. How much patience you have, for instance.
author: Franklin P. Jones

quote: Teach us, O Lord, the disciplines of patience, for to wait is often harder than to work.
author: Peter Marshall

quote: I have declared that patience is never more than patient. I too have declared, that I who am not patient am patient.
author: Gertrude Stein

quote: It is impossible to practice parliamentary politics without having patience, decency, politeness and courtesy.
author: Khaleda Zia

quote: I have all the patience in the world about Sirens. For me it's not a Grateful Dead project, it's a Me project.
author: Jerry Garcia

quote: The principle part of faith is patience.
author: George MacDonald

quote: Hopelessness has surprised me with patience.
author: Margaret J. Wheatley

quote: Find patience in the breath of life.
author: Ryunosuke Satoro

quote: The greatest power is often simple patience.
author: E. Joseph Cossman

quote: How can a society that exists on instant mashed potatoes, packaged cake mixes, frozen dinners, and instant cameras teach patience to its young?
author: Paul Sweeney

quote: Gardeners are good at nurturing, and they have a great quality of patience, they're tender. They have to be persistent.
author: Ralph Fiennes

quote: The first requirement of politics is not intellect or stamina but patience. Politics is a very long run game and the tortoise will usually beat the hare.
author: John Major

quote: I think patience is a skill and I wish I had it.
author: David Duchovny

quote: Patience can't be acquired overnight. It is just like building up a muscle. Every day you need to work on it.
author: Eknath Easwaran

quote: There is no substitute for hard work, 23 or 24 hours a day. And there is no substitute for patience and acceptance.
author: Cesar Chavez

quote: I can imagine few things more trying to the patience than the long wasted days of waiting.
author: Robert Falcon Scott

quote: I'm terrible with patience.
author: Katherine Heigl

quote: A final word: I am not knowledgeable about the internet. I do not have a computer. I guess that at 74 years of age, I don't have the patience to learn.
author: David Wilkerson

quote: It's a war of attrition. If you have patience and a modicum of faith in yourself your chances are not too bad.
author: Julie Bowen

quote: A show that no one thought had a chance has just finished its fifth year: Charmed. I think it's tougher for the younger networks, so I think they have a little more patience for the sake of the show. But who knows?
author: Aaron Spelling

quote: I don't play pyrotechnic scales. I play about frustration, patience, anger. Music is an extension of my soul.
author: Dick Dale

quote: Only those who have patience to do simple things perfectly ever acquire the skill to do difficult things easily.
author: James J. Corbett

quote: There are very little things in this life I cannot afford and patience is one of them.
author: Larry Hagman

quote: Luck is a component that a lot of people in the arts sometimes fail to recognise: that you can have talent, perseverance, patience, but without luck you will not have a successful career.
author: Bryan Cranston

quote: A statesman wants courage and a statesman wants vision but believe me, after six months' experience, he wants first, second, third and all the time - patience.
author: Stanley Baldwin

quote: My mum told me to have patience. It's about realising that when things aren't going the way you want them to, or you don't have inspiration, it will come.
author: Vanessa Paradis

quote: It has taken a great deal of energy, which has not been so difficult to summon as the necessary patience to wait, simply wait much of the time - until my instincts assured me that I had assembled my materials in proper order for a final welding into their natural form.
author: Hart Crane

quote: So when I do Chinese cooking, I mix everything together, then the kids have to eat their vegetables. They won't have the patience to pick them out.
author: Martin Yan

quote: I believe there's too little patience and context to many of the investigations I read or see on television.
author: Bob Woodward

quote: Artists know that diligence counts as much, if not more, as inspiration in art, as in politics, patience counts as much as revolution.
author: Tony Kushner

quote: Temperamentally I'm not a natural producer, because I don't have the patience.
author: Damian Lewis

quote: You have to respect your parents. They are giving you an at-bat. If you're an entrepreneur and go into the family business, you want to grow fast. Patience is important. But respect the other party... My dad and I pulled it off because we really respect each other.
author: Gary Vaynerchuk

quote: Deliberately seek opportunities for kindness, sympathy, and patience.
author: Evelyn Underhill

quote: Everyone is given one gift, a reason for being, and it's our obligation to do something with it. Obviously, it's a challenge - but if you're not taking the bull by the horns, I have no patience for you. You're just taking up space.
author: Melissa Rosenberg

quote: We are telling the American people to have patience, courage, resolve and determination.
author: Muammar al-Gaddafi

quote: I think I have more patience now than I did in the past.
author: T. Boone Pickens

quote: Because I'm the author of my screenplays I know what I'm looking for. It's true that I can be stubborn in demanding that I get what I want, but it's also a question of working with patience and love.
author: Michael Haneke

quote: Patience was not my strong point.
author: Lauren Bacall

quote: One problem with age is that patience begins to ebb.
author: Carl Hiaasen

quote: My biggest weakness is patience, wanting to see things happen too quickly or get changes in place right away. Not having the patience to let things develop.
author: Paul Gleason

quote: I haven't been given many things, but I've been given ample, limitless patience.
author: Lincoln Diaz-Balart

quote: When you read about a car crash in which two or three youngsters are killed, do you pause to dwell on the amount of love and treasure and patience parents poured into bodies no longer suitable for open caskets?
author: Jim Bishop

quote: Patience was not something that came naturally to me, but in cooking it is the quintessential skill.
author: Gail Simmons

quote: Patience is the secret to good food.
author: Gail Simmons

quote: You know, I lose patience really easily I'd rather shop in the grocery store than in the department store. I can pick an apple like nobody's business.
author: Gail Simmons

quote: Republican patience with how unionism deals with the political institutions, and with key issues like equality and human rights, will be tested because, obviously, there will be a battle a day on these matters. So lets face up to all of this with our eyes wide open.
author: Gerry Adams

quote: You have to find the peace and patience within yourself to be a model and an example to others and not judge.
author: Judith Light

quote: No, you're not allowed to be bossy when you're married. You have to learn compromise, and compassion and patience.
author: Star Jones

quote: People ask me a lot about the values I got from playing for the Cubs for so many years. The value I got out of it was patience. A lot of people these days are not very patient.
author: Ernie Banks

quote: I've worked so hard to eliminate the inner geek from my life. I suddenly realize I have no patience for those people who still have their geeks showing. Now I see why being 'normal' has been so important to me.

quote: Honestly, I didn't have the patience for biology or history in an academic sense, but I always liked the kind of big questions.
author: Andrew Bird

quote: In this day and age, you need a lot of patience if you are in the movie business.
author: Brett Ratner

quote: When I was in the first grade I was afraid of the teacher and had a miserable time in the reading circle, a difficulty that was overcome by the loving patience of my second grade teacher. Even though I could read, I refused to do so.
author: Beverly Cleary

quote: Give your dog or cat respect, patience, understanding and love. And if you just change to one vegetarian day a week, that's a wonderful step that will save animal lives. It means you have chosen something kind instead of something cruel.
author: Ingrid Newkirk

quote: In movies, there are some things the French do that Americans are increasingly incapable of doing. One is honoring the complexities of youth. It's a quiet, difficult undertaking, requiring subtlety in a filmmaker and perception and patience from us.
author: Wesley Morris

quote: I have no patience at all.
author: Alan Sugar

quote: Writing is good, thinking is better. Cleverness is good, patience is better.
author: Herman Hesse

quote: The strong manly ones in life are those who understand the meaning of the word patience.
author: Tokugawa Ieyasu

quote: And we ask the American people to play an important part of our layered defense. We ask for cooperation, patience and a commitment to vigilance in the face of a determined enemy.
author: Janet Napolitano

quote: When I said a few weeks ago that our people would eat cooking oil and olives if necessary, I didn't mean that there really would be only oil and olives. What I meant was that our people have the necessary patience to endure the current difficult situation. Palestinians would rather do without certain food items than their national rights.
author: Ismail Haniyeh

quote: I don't have a lot of patience for boring arthouse movies.
author: Zoe Kazan

quote: We had great faith that with patience, understanding, and education, that my family and I could be helpful in changing their minds and attitudes around.
author: Ryan White

quote: Secretary of War Stanton used to get out of patience with Lincoln because he was all the time pardoning men who ought to be shot.
author: Elihu Root

quote: My advice to someone to follow in my footsteps is to have patience. I've been doing this for twelve years.
author: Christina Milian

quote: Now it is evident that a little insight into the customs of every people is necessary to insure a kindly communication this, joined with patience and kindness, will seldom fail with the natives of the interior.
author: Charles Sturt

quote: Sad Patience, too near neighbour to despair.
author: Matthew Arnold

quote: Work hard. And have patience. Because no matter who you are, you're going to get hurt in your career and you have to be patient to get through the injuries.
author: Randy Johnson

quote: Is the patience of the American people that long suffering? Is there no outrage left in the country?
author: Andrew Greeley

quote: I've said my patience is not infinite.
author: Darrell Issa

quote: True enough, nature has endowed me with a fair measure of patience and composure, yet I should be lying if I told you that, having seen the reporter off on his way to make his deadline, I fell peacefully asleep.
author: Leon Jouhaux

quote: My impression is that most women public service workers have a long fuse. Precisely because they care so deeply about services, more than anyone, they still want to find a sensible and fair negotiated agreement. But their patience has run out.
author: Frances O'Grady

author: Dweezil Zappa

quote: Patience is passion tamed.
author: Lyman Abbott

quote: I'm not really easy to live with! There needs to be unlimited patience and unconditional love. Men I've known before loved my independent spirit and were proud of my success, to the point that they'd become jealous of the time I devote to my career.
author: Milla Jovovich

quote: I have a huge respect for writers and realise that this is not an area that I find easy. I doubt that I would have the patience in front of a blank sheet of paper to become a writer.
author: Jenny Agutter

quote: My relationship with the Philharmonia Orchestra brought me many times to London and I will always reflect positively on that early period of development with them - their patience, their warmth, their dedication.
author: Gustavo Dudamel

quote: Everything is out there if you know how to find it, and have the patience. I don't and haven't, but that's my problem.
author: Tom Holt

quote: Reading a novel in which all characters illustrate patience, hard work, chastity, and delayed gratification could be a pretty dull experience.
author: Thomas Perry

quote: I pray they will carry on in spite of that dreadful monster prejudice, and with patience, courage, fortitude and perseverance achieve success for themselves.
author: Major Taylor

quote: Americans have less and less patience for the intrusive and divisive moral scolds who thrived in the bubbles of the Clinton and Bush years.
author: Frank Rich

quote: I've always been a person with patience, and I don't like to force things.
author: Harry Shum, Jr.

quote: It seems likely that many of the young who don't wait for others to call them artists, but simply announce that they are, don't have the patience to make art.
author: Pauline Kael

quote: Tolerance, compromise, understanding, acceptance, patience - I want those all to be very sharp tools in my shed.
author: Cee Lo Green

quote: Patience means restraining one's inclinations.
author: Tokugawa Ieyasu

quote: The patience of the American public with dilatory diplomatic delays will be very limited.
author: Tom Lantos

quote: I wish I was a shredder that could play everything, but I don't have the patience.

author: Jeremy Sisto

quote: Patience makes a women beautiful in middle age.
author: Elliot Paul

quote: I think the Iraqi people have shown extraordinary patience and courage in the last few months. They have really put a political system on the way to success, to a real democracy here.
author: Paul Bremer

quote: The very important thing you should have is patience.
author: Jack Ma

quote: Speaking from my experience as a person involved for a long time in building the European Union, it is important to have patience and efforts to build a community of nations.
author: Giorgio Napolitano

quote: My wife is the most awesome person in the universe. She's made this experience much less miserable for me, with her compassion, patience and understanding.
author: Wil Wheaton

quote: Patience has never been my strong suit.
author: Michael Chiklis

quote: Constant repetition of tongue-twisters was like lifting weights for me, but patience and persistence have paid off.
author: Nicholas Brendon

quote: Your patience would fail you if I should continue to relate all the disrespectful speeches and treatment which your servants have been obliged to listen to and patiently to bear.
author: Peter Stuyvesant

quote: To understand a difficult topic like Iraq takes patience and care. Unfortunately, you rarely hear a patient, careful or thoughtful discussion of intelligence these days.
author: George Tenet

quote: I've learned the importance of loving what you do. I have also learned more patience due to the nature of the music business.
author: Randy Travis

quote: I haven't got a lot of patience.
author: Jeffrey Katzenberg

quote: It's amazing. My kids have grown me in ways I never knew possible. The patience I've received and the love I get from them is just amazing.
author: Candace Cameron Bure

quote: Anyhow, a philosophical turn of thought now was not amiss, else one's patience would have given out almost at the harbour entrance. The term of her probation was eight days.
author: Joshua Slocum

quote: Patience is sorrow's salve.
author: Charles Churchill

quote: You know, writing is really difficult, and it takes a real patience and a skill. I don't know if I have that. I admire it in others, so much, and I envy it.
author: Adam Scott

quote: Beauty, unlike the rest of the gifts handed out at birth, does not require dedication, patience and hard work to pay off. But it's also the only gift that does not keep on giving.
author: Paulina Porizkova

quote: My three Ps: passion, patience, perseverance. You have to do this if you've got to be a filmmaker.
author: Robert Wise

quote: Sometimes they are a matter of luck the photographer could not expect or hope for them. Sometimes they are a matter of patience, waiting for an effect to be repeated that he has seen and lost or for one that he anticipates.
author: Bill Brandt

quote: I think there's not much patience for organized labour, period, public or private sector.
author: Kathleen Wynne

quote: That's why I never became a director. I never had patience with people.
author: Ray Harryhausen

quote: Patience is the best medicine.
author: John Florio

quote: And so, at the age of thirty, I had successively disgraced myself with three fine institutions, each of which had made me free of its full and rich resources, had trained me with skill and patience, and had shown me nothing but forbearance and charity when I failed in trust.
author: Simon Raven

quote: He preacheth patience that never knew pain.
author: H. G. Bohn

quote: The only thing of weight that can be said against modern honor is that it is directly opposite to religion. The one bids you bear injuries with patience, the other tells you if you don't resent them, you are not fit to live.
author: Bernard de Mandeville

quote: I will exercise patience and will provide all facts to the general public.
author: Yingluck Shinawatra

quote: As I pass it, I feel as if I saw a dear old mother, sweet in her weakness, trembling at the approach of her dissolution, but not appealing to me against the inevitable, rather endeavouring to reassure me by her patience, and pointing to a hopeful future.
author: Thomas Edward Brown

quote: This is the story of what a Woman's patience can endure, and what a Man's resolution can achieve.
author: Wilkie Collins

quote: Soon I knew the craft of experimental physics was beyond me - it was the sublime quality of patience - patience in accumulating data, patience with recalcitrant equipment - which I sadly lacked.
author: Abdus Salam

quote: As a young boy, I read 'Cheaper by the Dozen' and immediately became neurotic about my use of time. It taxed me severely, but only for the next 50 years. But I think it also allowed me to discipline myself to sit in the chair and be a writer, where one of the most needed qualities is patience.
author: Ridley Pearson

quote: Difficult years lie ahead, patience is required.
author: Yiannis Stournaras

quote: If you have confidence you have patience. Confidence, that is everything.
author: Ilie Nastase

quote: So it's been a slow process and it's taken some patience. That's why patients are called patients I think - patience is required.
author: Bowie Kuhn

quote: I've done an awful lot of stuff that's a monument to public patience.
author: Tyrone Power

quote: It is easier to lead men to combat, stirring up their passion, than to restrain them and direct them toward the patient labors of peace.
author: Andre Gide

quote: Have courage for the great sorrows of life and patience for the small ones and when you have laboriously accomplished your daily task, go to sleep in peace.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: You have to find the peace and patience within yourself to be a model and an example to others and not judge.
author: Judith Light

quote: As anyone who has ever been around a cat for any length of time well knows, cats have enormous patience with the limitations of the human kind.
author: Cleveland Amory

quote: I am extraordinarily patient, provided I get my own way in the end.
author: Margaret Thatcher

quote: It is impossible to practice parliamentary politics without having patience, decency, politeness and courtesy.
author: Khaleda Zia

quote: The first requirement of politics is not intellect or stamina but patience. Politics is a very long run game and the tortoise will usually beat the hare.
author: John Major

quote: Artists know that diligence counts as much, if not more, as inspiration in art, as in politics, patience counts as much as revolution.
author: Tony Kushner

quote: The greatest power is often simple patience.
author: E. Joseph Cossman

quote: Let him that hath no power of patience retire within himself, though even there he will have to put up with himself.
author: Baltasar Gracian

quote: The relationship between a manufacturer and his advertising agency is almost as intimate as the relationship between a patient and his doctor. Make sure that you can life happily with your prospective client before you accept his account.
author: David Ogilvy

quote: Individual psychotherapy - that is, engaging a distressed fellow human in a disciplined conversation and human relationship - requires that the therapist have the proper temperament and philosophy of life for such work. author: Thomas Szasz

quote: In finding love, I think it's important to be patient. In being in a relationship, I think it's important to be honest, to communicate, to respect and trust, and to strive to give more than you take.
author: Kina Grannis

quote: In the book the relationship with Katharine and Almasy is sort of only in the patient's mind.
author: Michael Ondaatje

quote: Prior to passage of Obamacare, Americans spoke out against the individual mandate they didn't want to change the health care they had they didn't want a 3,000-page bill that empowered 15 Washington bureaucrats to decide the future of the doctor-patient relationship.
author: Fred Upton

quote: I think people are by-and-large happy with the providers that they have got now. They treasure that doctor-patient relationship.
author: Bob McDonnell

quote: My relationship with the Philharmonia Orchestra brought me many times to London and I will always reflect positively on that early period of development with them - their patience, their warmth, their dedication.
author: Gustavo Dudamel

quote: In finding love, I think it's important to be patient. In being in a relationship, I think it's important to be honest, to communicate, to respect and trust, and to strive to give more than you take.
author: Kina Grannis

quote: I'm not patient, and some things drive me crazy. In my work, I get incredibly upset when people don't get it right or don't respect others' needs.
author: Colin Firth

quote: You have to respect your parents. They are giving you an at-bat. If you're an entrepreneur and go into the family business, you want to grow fast. Patience is important. But respect the other party... My dad and I pulled it off because we really respect each other.
author: Gary Vaynerchuk

quote: Give your dog or cat respect, patience, understanding and love. And if you just change to one vegetarian day a week, that's a wonderful step that will save animal lives. It means you have chosen something kind instead of something cruel.
author: Ingrid Newkirk

quote: I have a huge respect for writers and realise that this is not an area that I find easy. I doubt that I would have the patience in front of a blank sheet of paper to become a writer.
author: Jenny Agutter

quote: Sad Patience, too near neighbour to despair.
author: Matthew Arnold

quote: There is no way that writers can be tamed and rendered civilized or even cured. The only solution known to science is to provide the patient with an isolation room, where he can endure the acute stages in private and where food can be poked in to him with a stick.
author: Robert A. Heinlein

quote: How can a society that exists on instant mashed potatoes, packaged cake mixes, frozen dinners, and instant cameras teach patience to its young?
author: Paul Sweeney

quote: The practice of patience toward one another, the overlooking of one another's defects, and the bearing of one another's burdens is the most elementary condition of all human and social activity in the family, in the professions, and in society.
author: Lawrence G. Lovasik

quote: The days of our lives, for all of us, are numbered. We know that. And yes, there are certainly times when we aren't able to muster as much strength and patience as we would like. It's called being human.
author: Elizabeth Edwards

quote: Every great dream begins with a dreamer. Always remember, you have within you the strength, the patience, and the passion to reach for the stars to change the world.
author: Harriet Tubman

quote: Patience and time do more than strength or passion.
author: Jean de La Fontaine

quote: Those who have the strength and the love to sit with a dying patient in the silence that goes beyond words will know that this moment is neither frightening nor painful, but a peaceful cessation of the functioning of the body.
author: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

quote: Endurance is nobler than strength, and patience than beauty.
author: John Ruskin

quote: Patience is the support of weakness impatience the ruin of strength.
author: Charles Caleb Colton

quote: If you would know strength and patience, welcome the company of trees.
author: Hal Borland

quote: Patience, persistence and perspiration make an unbeatable combination for success.
author: Napoleon Hill

quote: How many a man has thrown up his hands at a time when a little more effort, a little more patience would have achieved success.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: Deliberately seek opportunities for kindness, sympathy, and patience.
author: Evelyn Underhill

quote: A garden is a grand teacher. It teaches patience and careful watchfulness it teaches industry and thrift above all it teaches entire trust.
author: Gertrude Jekyll

quote: My teacher, my great cello teacher Leonard Rose, was such a great cellist, and nurturing man, very patient. But I grew up not only admiring him, but obviously Casals, Rostrotovich, Jacqueline du Pre, and many others, including many of my peers and contemporaries.
author: Yo-Yo Ma

quote: When I was in the first grade I was afraid of the teacher and had a miserable time in the reading circle, a difficulty that was overcome by the loving patience of my second grade teacher. Even though I could read, I refused to do so.
author: Beverly Cleary

quote: Developments in medical technology have long been confined to procedural or pharmaceutical advances, while neglecting a most basic and essential component of medicine: patient information management.
author: John Doolittle

quote: Patience and time do more than strength or passion.
author: Jean de La Fontaine

quote: It is strange that the years teach us patience that the shorter our time, the greater our capacity for waiting.
author: Elizabeth Taylor

quote: Never cut a tree down in the wintertime. Never make a negative decision in the low time. Never make your most important decisions when you are in your worst moods. Wait. Be patient. The storm will pass. The spring will come.
author: Robert H. Schuller

quote: If patience is worth anything, it must endure to the end of time. And a living faith will last in the midst of the blackest storm.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: How many a man has thrown up his hands at a time when a little more effort, a little more patience would have achieved success.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: The two most powerful warriors are patience and time.
author: Leo Tolstoy

quote: As anyone who has ever been around a cat for any length of time well knows, cats have enormous patience with the limitations of the human kind.
author: Cleveland Amory

quote: Alcohol is a very patient drug. It will wait for the alcoholic to pick it up one more time.
author: Mercedes McCambridge

quote: When traveling with someone, take large does of patience and tolerance with your morning coffee.
author: Helen Hayes

quote: A garden is a grand teacher. It teaches patience and careful watchfulness it teaches industry and thrift above all it teaches entire trust.
author: Gertrude Jekyll

quote: In finding love, I think it's important to be patient. In being in a relationship, I think it's important to be honest, to communicate, to respect and trust, and to strive to give more than you take.

quote: And so, at the age of thirty, I had successively disgraced myself with three fine institutions, each of which had made me free of its full and rich resources, had trained me with skill and patience, and had shown me nothing but forbearance and charity when I failed in trust.
author: Simon Raven

quote: Every therapeutic cure, and still more, any awkward attempt to show the patient the truth, tears him from the cradle of his freedom from responsibility and must therefore reckon with the most vehement resistance.
author: Alfred Adler

quote: It's a war of attrition. If you have patience and a modicum of faith in yourself your chances are not too bad.
author: Julie Bowen

quote: Competition makes things come out right. Well, what does that mean in health care? More hospitals so they compete with each other. More doctors compete with each other. More pharmaceutical companies. We set up war. Wait a minute, let's talk about the patient. The patient doesn't need a war.
author: Donald Berwick

quote: Have you ever thought that war is a madhouse and that everyone in the war is a patient?
author: Oriana Fallaci

quote: A wise man is superior to any insults which can be put upon him, and the best reply to unseemly behavior is patience and moderation.
author: Moliere

quote: Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: I have just three things to teach: simplicity, patience, compassion. These three are your greatest treasures.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Patience is the companion of wisdom.
author: Saint Augustine

quote: Deliberately seek opportunities for kindness, sympathy, and patience.
author: Evelyn Underhill

quote: Clearly older women and especially older women who have led an active life or elder women who successfully maneuver through their own family life have so much to teach us about sharing, patience, and wisdom.
author: Alice Walker

quote: The marvel of all history is the patience with which men and women submit to burdens unnecessarily laid upon them by their governments.
author: George Washington

quote: Clearly older women and especially older women who have led an active life or elder women who successfully maneuver through their own family life have so much to teach us about sharing, patience, and wisdom.
author: Alice Walker

quote: For anything worth having one must pay the price and the price is always work, patience, love, self-sacrifice - no paper currency, no promises to pay, but the gold of real service.
author: John Burroughs

quote: A sense of duty is useful in work but offensive in personal relations. People wish to be liked, not to be endured with patient resignation.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: But marriage goes in waves. You've got to be patient. People bail and give up on their marriages way too early. They just don't put the work and the effort into it. You've got to suck up your ego a lot of times, because that can be a big downfall.
author: Anna Benson

quote: Teach us, O Lord, the disciplines of patience, for to wait is often harder than to work.
author: Peter Marshall
